prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Home wait_info changes (won 6 of 15), adoption redesigns (won 3 of 6), finish redesigns (won 1 of 2), adoption new_flows (won 1 of 2), sign_in notifications (won 1 of 4), and finish new_screens (won 1 of 6) generated winning tests.
Finish hints, sign_in redesigns, sign_in incentives, choose_path layouts, and choose_path redesigns showed no positive effect and frequently caused negative performance.
Adoption hints, choose_path copy, finish layouts, finish new_flows, home redesigns, and sign_in copy showed no clear effect across multiple tests.
Kinds of change tested only once (adoption new_screen, adoption wait_info, choose_path hint, finish reorder, home new_flow, sign_in hint, sign_in reorder) remain thin evidence.
Predictions were systematically too low for major winning redesigns/flows and too high for changes that had no clear effect or negative outcomes.

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Multi-Stage Pet Customization Flow: Add an extra customization review screen before rendering to verify pet appearance options. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pets failing or rendering incorrectly, and adoption new_flows have proven effective.)
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop Habitat Generation Live Status Display: Display dynamic setup progress metrics and estimated completion times during pet rendering. (why: Home wait_info tests have won 6 of 15 tests, addressing long waiting room durations (median 201s, mean 2336s).)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Pet Quick Action Hub Screen: Introduce a dedicated final screen that demonstrates how to access desktop options and control pet audio. (why: Addresses post-onboarding user confusion regarding hiding and talking to companions after setup completes.)
3: [home, wait_info] Waiting Stage Ambient Soundscape Info: Provide background habitat audio hints and status cards during companion asset loading. (why: Lowering perceived loading duration addresses high drop-off during long generation waits.)
4: [sign_in, notification] Account Data Preservation Sign-In Notice: Show an informational banner during sign-in reassuring users that existing pet progress is safely restored. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding missing or reset pets after signing back into an account.)
5: [adoption, layout] Pick Friend Dual Column Character Layout: Update pick_friend layout to a balanced two-column presentation comparing pet abilities side-by-side. (why: Simplifies comparison to speed up the decision process (median 89s).)
6: [finish, notification] Desktop Visibility Control Completion Banner: Add an action hint banner explaining desktop tray shortcuts right before entering the home desktop view. (why: Directly tackles support feedback regarding pet visibility and desktop navigation.)
7: [choose_path, reorder] Onboarding Narrative Intro Reorder: Reorder the introductory story screen to precede path selection to provide complete context beforehand. (why: Choose_path has a high drop-off rate (76.2% conversion, 514s mean time) indicating initial friction.)
